name: capture-references
description: Pull references (URLs or topics) from the web, summarize each with a freshness format, and append them to the project's REFERENCES.md for later tasks. Use when the user persists project-level references, supplies URLs, has a reference that outlives the task, or seeds REFERENCES.md. Do not use when the project folder is missing (run project-bootstrap), the input is task-internal, a codebase observation (use capture-observation), or a decision (use decision-interview or direction-adjust).
